Mayank Bhayana mayankbhayana9@gmail.com

LinkedIn . Credly

With over 13 years in IT and 6+ years as a record of driving product strategy, vision and innovation across core Digital Environment. Proven expertise in AI/GenAI product development, Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, Azure DevOps, Agentic AI, RAG, AI-driven product delivery, Data Analytics, Agile/Scrum and SAFe methodologies.

and 7 years in Product Development, I have a proven track

Strong engineering professional with a Post-Graduation-Advance Diploma focused in Wireless and Mobile Computing from CDAC ACTS, Bengaluru; Certified in Hands-on Approach to AI for Real-World Applications (HAAI - IIT Kharagpur).

Tata Consultancy Services Technical Product Owner

Jan 2024– Present 2 years 7 months

Led the rollout of VIA from a GenAI agent-assist to an Agentic AI co-pilot, cutting email handling time from 25+

mins to 2 mins, clearing 90% of a 12K backlog in 8 weeks, improving SLA from 33 to <5 days, reducing backlog by 90%, and delivering ~40% cost savings with sustained CSAT uplift.

Led discovery, analysis and requirements gathering for multilingual AI chatbots (NL/FR/EN), improving intent recognition accuracy to 98% and reducing fallback rate by 30%; write Epics/Features/Stories with DoR/DoD, AC, and NFRs. Impact - Reduced hallucinate rate to≤ 2% and p95 latency to≤ 2 s with caching and retrieval tuning.

Optimized Backlog Prioritization with MOSCOW/WSJF/RICE; accelerating feature delivery by 25% and

improving sprint predictability across the Agile Release Train; run PI Planning, PO Sync and System Demos; manage dependencies, manage Risks, and capacity allocation across trains, fares, disruptions.

Led product delivery for AI and GenAI solutions on Microsoft Azure, working closely with Azure architects,

engineering, data and AI teams to drive scalable and production-ready solutions.

Leveraged Azure OpenAI for enterprise GenAI and conversational AI use cases, evaluating model

performance, response quality, hallucination, latency and business outcomes

Used Azure DevOps for product backlog management, sprint planning, user-story tracking, release

coordination, dependency management and Agile delivery governance.

Worked with technical teams on Azure-based RAG and AI solutions, covering retrieval, embeddings, content

management, evaluation, performance and production readiness.

Translated business and technical requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria and

NFRs for Azure-based AI products, aligning product roadmap with technical feasibility and business priorities.

Design & govern the RAG Pipeline: content source selection, retrieval schemas (chunking strategy

/metadata), embeddings, and freshness SLAs, citations, versioning, ownership, and vectors.

Led LLM augmentation of the NLU bot by evaluating GPT-4o (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) for long-tail, multi-turn

queries, improving first-contact resolution by 25% and reducing fallback rate by 30%.

Own the AI product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Mobi & Norio chatbots; translate business goals

(containment, task-success, CSAT, NPS, automation ROI) into OKRs and an executable backlog aligned to SAFe ART objectives.

Deliver omni-channel experiences (Mobile apps, Web, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, IVR), ensuring

session/state continuity and reducing agent handoff time by 40%.

Increased HR self-service adoption by 40% by deflecting policy Q&A to the Norio chatbot and enabling

context-aware escalation to HR specialists.

Executed Try Before You Buy (TBYB) journey, increasing customer activation by 38% and reducing churn by

12%.

Applied WSJF & RICE prioritization, accelerating delivery of high-ROI features and improving sprint velocity

by 15%.

• Led AI-driven personalization, boosting digital engagement and feature adoption by 22% and leveraged Big

Data-driven analytics, enabling users to experience trial versions of services before purchasing.

• Define, monitor, and iterate on KPIs and metrics across journeys, teams, and product features, including

CSAT, NPS, feature adoption, and customer retention rate.

Integrated digital identity verification (Onfido, Jumio), reducing manual KYC effort by 90% and improving

onboarding time by 50%.

Led evaluation and strategic adoption of AI/ML-driven AML and Fraud monitoring solutions, improving

detection effectiveness and reducing false positives.

Built and Assessed ML model algorithms, performance, explainability, regulatory defensibility, and operational

impact to enable compliant, data-driven decisioning.

Delivered ML-based product improvements, increasing feature adoption by 30% and retention by 12%.

NextGen Healthcare Technical Product Owner

May 2020– Sep 2023

3 years 5 months

Built Customer Support Diagnostics & Chatbot, incorporated ML and Generative AI models, reducing

support tickets by 35% and improving resolution time by 40%.

Improved app rating from 1.5 to 4.5 via increased rigor on customer-focused enhancements and rigorous QA. • Delivered IMO Modifiers Search (HL7 & HIPAA compliant), enabling seamless payment initiation and reducing claim errors by 20%.

Worked with healthcare compliance, clinical workflows (EHR Data), legal regulations and digital identity tools to

verify provider credentials and ensure HIPAA-aligned secure access control.

JIRA: Conducted Root Cause Analysis and Data Mapping to support customer support automation. • Troubleshoot and Investigate Client Production Issues in NGMS app, Created User Stories & Estimations, Functional Reviews, Business Requirement Document, Implemented Pagination.

Identify, Manage and Minimize project risks by conducting standard RAID Analysis. • Migrated legacy code from Objective-C to Swift, PR Reviews, leveraging VIPER architecture and modern concurrency, reducing crash rate by 28%.

Worked on mModal (Cloud Based Online/Offline Dictation) Integration in NextGen Mobility Solutions - iOS

Litmus7 Senior Product Developer

Sep 2019– Mar 2020 7 months

Developed video streaming features using AVFoundation, improving engagement by 15%.

Textron Inc. Senior Software Engineer

May 2013– Sep 2019 6 years 5 months

Built offline/online order management for field service apps on Salesforce Cloud and SF Client Credentials;

OAuth 2.0 User-Agent Flow, reducing sync failures by 50%.

Developed Greenlee Pulling Calculator iOS App, achieving 10K+ downloads and 4.8 rating on App Store.

Migrated enterprise websites to Drupal & Magento CMS, reducing maintenance effort by 50%.

Designed wireframes for the industrial websites under E-Z-GO, by using Microsoft Visio.

Tech Stack: Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI (GenAI), Agentic AI, Machine Learning (ML), NLP, Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, Azure DevOps, AWS, GCP, Data Analytics, Big Data, Security Core Competencies: Product Discovery, Product Ideation, Product Vision, Product Strategy, Product Roadmap, Product Backlog, Product Prioritization, Product Design, Business Analysis, Backlog Refinement, Product Development, User Research, Product Metrics and Analytics, OKRs, KPIs, Databricks, Data Analysis, Market Analysis, Stakeholder Management, A/B Tests, SAFe, Scrum, Kanban

Programming Languages: Objective-C, Swift, Core Java, Python, SQL Tools: Aha, Figma, Trello, Rally, Asana, Maze, Lucidchart, Balsamiq, Xray, Miro, Mixpanel, Azure DevOps, JIRA, API, Confluence, Cloud Computing, Power BI, Tableau, Postman, Xcode, GitHub, Amplitude, RACI Matrix

Certifications: CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, AWS Partner: Agentic AI Sales and Agentic AI Essentials, SAFe RTE, IBM Enterprise Design Thinking– AI, AWS AI Practitioner

Indian Institute of Technology / IIT, Kharagpur Certification, Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Sep 2024 - Mar 2025

Centre for Development of Advanced Computing / C-DAC, Bengaluru Post Graduation Advance Diploma, Wireless and Mobile Computing
